name: NeoForge mod
summary: A NeoForge mod for Minecraft: Java Edition 26.x, built with Gradle and ModDevGradle.
description: A Gradle project in the shape of the official NeoForge MDK: neoforge.mods.toml, a main class marked with @Mod and, as options, a client class, an item and a command. Needs JDK 25, which Gradle can download by itself.

options.label: Mod name
options.patternHelp: start with a letter, at least two characters; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only
options.help: The mod id is this name in lower case with underscores (My Mod becomes my_mod). The id names files and folders, so do not change it later.

options.label: Author
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only
options.help: Goes into the Java package (com.author.modname) and the authors line.

options.label: Description
options.help: One line shown in the mod list.

options.label: Minecraft version
options.help: The official MDK has the same build file for all three.

options.label: NeoForge version
options.help: Leave empty to use the version from the official MDK for the Minecraft version above (26.3.0.101, 26.2.0.93 or 26.1.2.126). It must start with the Minecraft version. Newer ones are listed on projects.neoforged.net.

options.label: Gradle version
options.help: The Gradle that the wrapper downloads.

options.label: Client class
options.help: A second @Mod class that only loads on the client, for rendering, screens and key binds.

options.label: Example item
options.help: A registered item with its model, name and a place in the creative inventory.

options.label: Example command
options.help: A slash command named after the mod id.

next: Open the folder in IntelliJ IDEA and let it import the Gradle project (the first import downloads Minecraft and takes a while). From a terminal instead, run once: gradle wrapper
Test in a development game: gradlew runClient
Build the jar: gradlew build. It lands in build\libs.
Copy the jar to .minecraft\mods and start the NeoForge profile.
Look for the mod's loaded line in logs\latest.log. Your code starts in the constructor of the main class.
